title: carpha alpina var. schoenoides
intro: Carpha alpina var. schoenoides, commonly known as alpine club-rush, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in East Asia, where it is valued for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Carpha alpina var. schoenoides are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties, which help to soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
